svg.title: The threads: fifty-eight lessons in eight strands
svg.desc: The book's method at the bottom, then the strands that follow its parts: reality and explanation, self and cognition, cooperation and political economy, discourse and morals, artificial intelligence, the four moves and institutions, and practice.
svg.text: The threads: fifty-eight lessons in eight strands
Read from the bottom. The method strand is what every other lesson assumes: mark the standing of a claim, count agreement only across independent routes, agree on
shape and keep content plural, keep open what is open.
Two truths: act on practice, keep foundations open
Niskama karma: full competence, no stake in the fruit
Indra's Net: the pattern of relations is the unit
Political economy: who gains, who pays
Integrate the moves; never apply one alone
Align to what, how and with whom
Design against the five failure modes
Defer under preference uncertainty; treat oversight as information
Align the swarm and its shared medium
Design diversity in; discount same-lineage agreement
Separate frame, record and probability in risk claims
Prefer bounded, reversible action under ignorance
Hold moral status open; graduate treatment to uncertainty
Do not tie worth to usefulness
Pass the discourse test: who drafted it?
Publish whose preferences shaped the system
Declare the mode: inquiry or advocacy
Stand on the seven convergences; give no default on the five disagreements
Weigh sources fairly and keep their own terms
Govern shared resources by Ostrom's principles
Judge deployments by their effect on cooperation's infrastructure
Forecast in windows and scopes, never destinies
Treat self-reports as evidence to check, not testimony to trust
Describe self-like layers; neither assert nor deny a self
Align the selection environment, not only the vehicle
Reward the act, not the fruit
Audit bias in aggregate, across four layers
Prefer explanations that are hard to vary
Pair every generator with a critic it cannot charm
Climb the causal ladder only with declared structure
Treat scaling curves as fits, not laws
Tag the level of every behavioural claim
Mark the standing of every claim
Count agreement only across independent routes
Converge on shape; keep content plural
Name your limits and your coverage
Trace every figure to its source; quote briefly
the book states the rule for AI
this lab derived the rule from the chapter's argument
can also be carried in context (a prompt); the rest need code, architecture or people
